verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that the Management API can order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location. That is an adjacent fleet-procurement step, not documented API creation of a new location/store or registration of readers to it. Nothing in the pack shows an agent can provision a location end-to-end via API.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
